sessions.notes: Baseline run. H1 and H2 were originally ACCEPTED / CONDITIONALLY ACCEPTED; both were later found on external audit (Session 002) to be RESTATED (H1, single-paper restatement of PMID 40184040) and Established consensus (H2, since ~2016-2018) respectively. This is the founding failure case for the whole novelty-gating system (see immunology_pipeline.md preamble).

Introduced mandatory Agent 9 novelty gating; re-audited H1/H2 from Session 001 (see graph/novelty_audit.json audits[]). No hypothesis reached ACCEPT at the Agent-10 stage in this session -- 0/0, distinct from a 0% false-positive rate.
Graph unchanged from Session 002 (949 nodes / 753 edges at the time). Added IBD cross-disease graph + cross_disease_motifs.json.
